body:
Closes #7

Ticket: [ALBUM-7](https://github.com/dbeallor/album-ranker/issues/7). Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-21-album-7-elo-matchup.md`. Plan: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-21-album-7-elo-matchup.md`.

Adds the Elo rating engine (`lib/elo/`, pure: update, replay with implied results, artist score, matchup picking), a loader and answer/skip/undo logic (`lib/ratings.ts`, `lib/matchups-service.ts`), and the `/matchups` screen. Ratings are replayed on each request and never stored. No schema changes.

## Proof

- **A wins between two new albums gives 1516 / 1484; a 1500 v 1500 tie changes nothing; replay is deterministic**: `lib/elo/elo.test.ts` (table) and `lib/elo/replay.test.ts` pass.

  ```
  $ npx vitest run lib/elo lib/matchups-service components/matchup-screen
   Test Files  6 passed (6)
        Tests  58 passed (58)
  ```

- **Implied results are exactly ranked over lower ranked and over honorable mention**: `impliedResults` test in `lib/elo/replay.test.ts` (fixture year with ranks 1, 2, 4, honorable mentions and a listed album).
- **Answering changes both ratings; undo restores them exactly**: `lib/matchups-service.test.ts` ("an answer moves both ratings", "undo restores the ratings exactly"), against an in-memory database; `replay.test.ts` covers the same at the engine level.
- **Never same-year, listed, or already-played pair while an unplayed one exists**: `lib/elo/pick.test.ts` and "never serves a listed or unplaced album" in `lib/matchups-service.test.ts`; the answer action refuses same-year, listed, unplaced and unknown pairs and stores nothing.
- **Artist score of albums rated 1600 and 1700 is 1600**: `lib/elo/artist-score.test.ts`.
- **Screen covered by a component test**: `components/matchup-screen.test.tsx` (pick, tie, skip, undo, counter, undo disabled at zero).

  ```
  $ npm test && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
  Tests  131 passed (131)   (lint and typecheck: no output; build compiled, /matchups is dynamic)
  ```

Not proven:
- The screen in a real browser: no browser test setup in the repo, and `/matchups` has no data to show until albums can be added to years (#6) or imported (#10). No screenshot.

Context size: pass skipped (not collective-wisdom)

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

comments.body:
## Code review (pass 1)

PR #21, head `36f497b3d1b805a65f0094525ca3f29e5ef04218`.

Checked the Elo update, implied results, replay order, picking and its fallback, artist score, the answer/skip/undo service, the server actions, the page and the client screen against the spec. Re-ran the Proof commands: 58 targeted tests and the full 131 pass; typecheck and lint are clean. Every acceptance item has evidence that exercises it, and `Not proven` is honest.

**Should fix**
1. `components/matchup-screen.tsx:51`: the previous answer line survives an undo it no longer describes, because `undoMatchup` returns `lastAnswer: null` when an album lost its placement (`lib/matchups-service.ts:113`).

**Nit**
2. `lib/ratings.ts:33,42`: `loadMatchupState` returns `ratings`, which no caller reads.
3. `lib/matchups-service.ts`: `round` only wraps `Math.round`; inline it.
4. `lib/elo/pick.ts`: `unplayedOpponents` is rebuilt for the chosen album, and each answer runs three replays. Fine at MVP size (spec: no cache); noted for later.

Tests are proportionate: tables per rule, no styling tests.

Verdict: PASS

## Code review (pass 2)

Head `fa231347a88ad6600d148b696c36d00fd25666ca`. The only change since pass 1 is fa23134, a one-line edit at `lib/matchups-service.ts:114`.

The pass 1 should-fix is resolved. Undo now always returns a line, so the client no longer keeps the undone answer on screen. Every undo path checked: both albums rated (rating change shown, pair served again), an album lost its placement (`Undone.` and a fresh pair), nothing to undo (error, unchanged). Skip is the only action that returns `lastAnswer: null`, so the client's comment is accurate. No regressions: 20/20 targeted tests, typecheck and lint clean.

**Nit:** nothing tests the `Undone.` fallback. Not required.

Verdict: PASS

## Security review (pass 1)

PR #21, head `fa231347a88ad6600d148b696c36d00fd25666ca`. Checked against OWASP Top 10:2025 and ASVS V4, V5 and V8. No LLM or agent code in the diff.

| # | Severity | Location | Finding |
|---|----------|----------|---------|
| 1 | Info | `app/matchups/actions.ts` | The actions, including undo (which deletes a row), have no auth. Expected: the password gate is #14. Next's Origin check covers cross-site POSTs and `allowedOrigins` is not loosened. |
| 2 | Info | `undoMatchup` / `undoLastMatchup` | Undo takes no matchup id, so a replayed POST deletes one more row. Consider passing the expected id once #14 lands. |
| 3 | Info | `parseAvoid` | `avoid` is validated (array, capped, each entry `^\d+-\d+$`) and used only for Set lookups. Each action replays all ratings, which costs CPU but is fine at this scale. |

Passed: runtime input validation of ids, result and pair (the actions take `unknown`); parameterized SQL only; fixed or `DataError` messages, with a generic message on the client; no raw HTML rendering and cover URLs built from a MusicBrainz id; no secrets, `.env`, `data/` or SQLite files in the diff; `server-only` boundary intact.

Verdict: PASS

## Docs check

DOCS CHECK fa23134 (origin/main...HEAD): 3 findings, 2 fixed, 1 rejected.
Docs checked: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-21-album-7-elo-matchup.md, docs/superpowers/as-built/2026-11-21-album-7-elo-matchup.md at fa23134
Rejected: `docs/agents/project.md` § Areas (`lib/` "Elo later"): it is team config, the ticket doesn't ask to change it, and the database and catalog parts were already stale; left for a ticket that owns it.

Head moved to f34ea9a018ad9b1e5cc555e331a7e1bfc75b0324; PR diff changed only in docs files since fa231347a88ad6600d148b696c36d00fd25666ca: 'docs/superpowers/as-built/2026-11-21-album-7-elo-matchup.md', 'docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-21-album-7-elo-matchup.md'. Reviews from fa231347a88ad6600d148b696c36d00fd25666ca stand.
